title: Explicit pointwise native small-model Hom comparison
statement: For each normalized native Hom comparison H, unlift the small-site slice Hom and reverse H through the actual native section-equivalence unit and counit. This constructs, for each pair of small-site modules M,N, an isomorphism E(Hom(M,N)) ≅ nativeHom(E(M),E(N)), with E and the coefficient ring fixed by [def-sf-native-frobenius-model-data].

lean.statement:
def homComparison (H : AdicModuleHomComparisonCore l Y)
    (M N : TwistedActionRingedSite.Modules (ring Y l)) :
    (equivalence Y l).functor.obj (SheafOfModules.homObj (R := ring Y l) M N) ≅
      (nativeHom Y l).obj (op ((equivalence Y l).functor.obj M),
        (equivalence Y l).functor.obj N)
